scope: Existing genuine 0.16.26 full +12 benchmark verified, plus final 0.16.27 native first-room entry and public cap-ascension proof. No new full battle runs.
limitations: Preparation grants acquired ownership, grown stats, naturally generated artifacts, equipment and finite items; it does not prove complete natural account procurement.
12F artifacts use the first naturally gate-qualified roll, up to 4000 per owner, not fixed best-of-80. Actual sample attempts are reported.
Three seeds per constellation with the fixed native roster/control policy are observational cases, not a population win-rate estimate.
Final source retains native Abyss combat policies; earlier complete combat results are preserved separately and not counted as new runs.
